editorial_notes: 30 Scholar records resolve to 23 papers/technical reports and one lecture-note contribution; five duplicate/alternate records consolidated and one astronomy record excluded.
Corporate NVIDIA authorship follows arXiv; Gantavya Bhatt is present in the full author lists for all four reports, beyond Scholar truncation for Ultra and Super.
Lecture notes are credited to Amitabha Bagchi with a separately stated contribution, as the primary PDF lists Gantavya among contributors rather than as a cover author.
Final publisher metadata supersedes preprint titles/years and erroneous Scholar fields. Original Google Sites publication records stay archived unchanged.
Backdoor TMLR final PDF says 12/2024; LabelBench journal PDF says 3/2024; imitation thresholds is TMLR 2025; JPO is Findings of ACL 2025.
Existing equal-contribution markers retained where supported by the source record or final paper. Unsupported standalone markers were omitted.
